table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	saleLedgermodified.saleinvcode , 
	saleledgermodified.editablesaleinvcode,
	salecatcode =saleLedgermodified.salecatcode , 
	date = saleLedgermodified.date , 
	custrefno =saleLedgermodified.custrefno , 
	remarks = saleLedgermodified.remarks , 
	custcode = saleLedgermodified.custcode , 
	salesmancode = saleLedgermodified.salesmancode ,
	headerno = saleLedgermodified.headerno,  
	username = users.username , 
	discperc = saleLedgermodified.discperc , 
	flatdisc = saleLedgermodified.flatdisc , 
	misccharges = saleLedgermodified.misccharges , 
	salestax = saleLedgermodified.salestax , 
	posted = saleLedgermodified.posted , 
	postdate = saleLedgermodified.postdate , 
	address = customer.address1 , 
	city = customer.city , 
	phone = customer.phone ,
	customerbalance = 0,
	debitorcredit = ' ',
	aliasname=(SELECT Accounts.AliasName FROM Accounts WHERE AccCode = saleLedgermodified.CustCode),
	headerinvno = saleLedgermodified.headerinvno,
	originaldate = saleLedgermodified.originaldate,
	modifiedby = saleLedgermodified.modifiedby,
	sprice = saleLedgermodified.sprice,
	quotationno = saleLedgermodified.quotationno,
	postedby = saleLedgermodified.postedby,
	doctcode = saleLedgermodified.doctcode,
	patientRegNo='          ',
	patientcode = saleLedgermodified.patientcode,
	cashreceived,
	invGSTPerc1=saleLedgermodified.InvGstPerc1,
	dd_gstperc=0,
	gcode=0,
	saleLedgermodified.gstno,
	printwaranty = saleLedgermodified.PrintWaranty,
	printbatch = saleLedgermodified.PrintBatch,
	messagecode = saleLedgermodified.MessageCode,
	Message.Description,
	smancode = saleLedgermodified.SmanCode,
	salesman_name = Salesman.Name,
	custrefno2 = saleLedgermodified.custrefno2,
	custrefno3 = saleLedgermodified.custrefno3,
	custrefno4 = saleLedgermodified.custrefno4,
	invoicesize = saleLedgermodified.InvoiceSize,
	invtotal = saleLedgermodified.invtotal,
	machinename = saleLedgermodified.machinename,
	modifycounter = saleLedgermodified.ModifyCounter,
	wardcode = saleLedgermodified.wardcode,
	diseasecode = saleLedgermodified.diseasecode,
	relationcode = saleLedgermodified.relationcode,
	itemdiscpercno = saleLedgermodified.itemdiscpercno,
	printbalance = saleledgermodified.printbalance,
	deliveredby = saleledgermodified.deliveredby,
	billingdate = saleledgermodified.billingdate,
	pptcustcode = saleledgermodified.pptcustcode,
	admissioncode = saleLedgermodified.admissioncode,
	saletypecode = saleLedgermodified.saletypecode,
	recurringinvoice=saleLedgermodified.recurringinvoice,
	recurringperiod=saleLedgermodified.recurringperiod,
	recurringagainst=saleLedgermodified.recurringagainst,
	DueDate=saleLedgermodified.DueDate,
	CustRefNo5=saleLedgermodified.CustRefNo5,
	custsitecode=saleledgermodified.custsitecode,
	PreviousReading=saleledgermodified.PreviousReading,
	CurrentReading=saleledgermodified.CurrentReading,
	NextChange=saleledgermodified.NextChange

FROM  
	customer , 
	saleLedgermodified 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN SalesMan ON (saleLedgermodified.smancode = salesman.salesmancode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN Message  ON (saleLedgermodified.messagecode = message.messagecode), 
	users , 
	accounts  
WHERE 
	( saleLedgermodified.custcode = customer.custcode ) and 
	( users.usercode = saleLedgermodified.salesmancode ) and 
	( saleLedgermodified.custcode = accounts.acccode ) and 
	( dbo.saleLedgermodified.saleinvcode = :ar_SaleInvCode )
